text: Under the Test Rural Udyog Yojana, the rate of interest chargeable on loans sanctioned under this scheme shall be 12.0% per annum, reducing balance, unless a state-specific circular states otherwise. This is a synthetic test fixture and does not describe any real scheme.

The repayment tenure under the Test Rural Udyog Yojana shall not exceed 60 months, inclusive of any moratorium. A moratorium period of 6 months on principal repayment is available at the borrower's option. Synthetic test fixture text.

For units sanctioned in the State of Bihar under the Test Rural Udyog Yojana, the rate of interest chargeable shall be 10.5% per annum, reducing balance, in place of the national baseline rate. Synthetic test fixture text.

The promoter's minimum margin contribution for units sanctioned under this circular in Bihar shall be 10% of the project cost. Synthetic test fixture text; this is a percentage of project cost, not an absolute rupee figure.
The registration fee payable for a retail grocery establishment under this synthetic test schedule is Rs. 500. This is a fictional fee schedule for test purposes only.
Typical inventory holding for a rural grocery outlet surveyed by this synthetic test trade body was 30 days. This is a fictional benchmark for test purposes only, not a real industry survey.

Under the Test Conflict Scheme, the applicable rate of interest in Bihar shall be 11.0% per annum. Synthetic test fixture text, deliberately inconsistent with a second fixture document for the same scheme.

Under the Test Conflict Scheme, the applicable rate of interest in Bihar shall be 13.0% per annum. Synthetic test fixture text, deliberately inconsistent with a second fixture document for the same scheme.
Under the Test Stale Scheme, a capital subsidy of 15% of project cost was available for units sanctioned before 31 December 2023. Synthetic test fixture text describing a deliberately expired rule.

Under the Test Conditional Scheme, a security deposit equivalent to 2 months of EMI is required, subject to the unit qualifying for a fictional collateral-free guarantee cover described elsewhere in this synthetic test document.

Some commentators believe the effective rate under the Test Secondary Only Scheme works out to around 9.0% per annum. Synthetic test fixture text — an uncredentialed secondary source that must never supply a binding rate.
Under the Test Quote Mismatch Scheme, the moratorium period is 6 months from the date of disbursement. Synthetic test fixture text.
